tools.name: audit_families
tools.description: Audit the loaded families: unused ones (Purge Unused list), in-place families, near-duplicate names ("Porta 80" vs "Porta 80 2" / "(1)" / "copy"), families with too many types, and optionally geometric complexity (solids/faces of one sample instance per family, within timeBudgetMs). Counts per section and family ids/names. Read-only: use purge_unused to remove.

sections.description: What to audit (default unused, inPlace, duplicateNames, manyTypes): unused, inPlace, duplicateNames, manyTypes, complexity (slow).

categories.description: Only families of these categories (any language). Default: all loadable families.

typeCountThreshold.description: manyTypes: report families with more types than this, 1-1000 (default 30).

limit.description: Items listed per section, 1-2000 (default 100); counts are always complete.

timeBudgetMs.description: complexity: stop sampling after this many milliseconds, 1000-300000 (default 20000).

tools.name: audit_sheets_views
tools.description: Audit sheets and views: views and schedules not placed on any sheet (templates, dependent working views and excludeViewNames ignored), schedules with no rows, sheets with no views, sheets without a title block, and sheets missing required parameters (drawn by, checked by, issue date by default). Counts per section plus ids/names. Read-only: nothing is deleted.

sections.description: What to audit (default all): unplacedViews, unplacedSchedules, emptySchedules, emptySheets, sheetsWithoutTitleBlock, sheetParameters.

requiredSheetParameters.description: Sheet parameters that must have a value (e.g. "Desenhado por", {builtIn: SHEET_DRAWN_BY}). Default: drawn by, checked by, issue date.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

excludeViewNames.description: Regex: views whose name matches are ignored (working views), e.g. "^(WORK|TRAB|x_)".

limit.description: Items listed per section, 1-2000 (default 100); counts are always complete.

tools.name: check_clashes
tools.description: Detect clashes between set A and set B (or A against itself): each set by categories, explicit element ids and/or a Revit link. solid mode computes the real intersection volume (m3) and centre (mm) of each clashing pair; bbox mode only compares bounding boxes. Joined and host/hosted pairs are skipped by default. Bounded by maxPairs and timeBudgetMs (truncated says so). Read-only.

categories.description: Categories in any language (OST_Ducts / Ducts / Dutos). With link, taken from the linked model.

elementIds.description: Explicit elements: id, UniqueId or "linkInstanceId:elementId" for linked elements.

link.description: Revit link instance id or name: take the categories from that linked model instead of the host.

setB.description: Second set. Omit to check set A against itself.

categories.description: Categories in any language (OST_Ducts / Ducts / Dutos). With link, taken from the linked model.

elementIds.description: Explicit elements: id, UniqueId or "linkInstanceId:elementId" for linked elements.

link.description: Revit link instance id or name: take the categories from that linked model instead of the host.

mode.description: solid (default): real intersection volume of the solids; bbox: bounding boxes only (fast, many false positives).

tolerance.description: Grow the bounding boxes by this much before comparing (bbox mode and pre-filter). Default 0. Unit: mm.

minVolume.description: solid mode: ignore intersections smaller than this (default 0.0001 m3 = 100 cm3; 0 keeps every touch).

ignoreJoined.description: Skip pairs joined with Join Geometry and host/hosted pairs (door in its wall). Default true.

maxElementsPerSet.description: Refuse sets larger than this, 1-50000 (default 10000); narrow the categories or use a link/elementIds.

timeBudgetMs.description: Stop after this many milliseconds and return what was found (truncated), 1000-600000 (default 30000).

tools.name: check_levels_grids
tools.description: Check levels and grids: levels at the same elevation (within tolerance, mm), building-story levels without a floor plan (or ceiling plan), duplicated or overlapping grids (same line/arc within tolerance) and straight grids slightly off the orthogonal axes. Lists every level with its elevation in mm. Read-only.

tolerance.description: Distance under which two levels or grids count as duplicated/overlapping (default 1 mm).

requireFloorPlan.description: Report building-story levels with no floor plan (default true).

requireCeilingPlan.description: Report building-story levels with no ceiling plan (default false).

offAxisAngle.description: Report straight grids that are off the orthogonal axes by more than 0.001 deg but less than this (default 1 deg): usually drawing mistakes.

tools.name: check_naming
tools.description: Check view names, sheet numbers, level names and family type names against the office naming convention (read from knowledge/nomenclatura.md and folhas.md 'Formato:' lines, or explicit regexes in patterns) and for hygiene problems ("Copy"/"Cópia"/"(2)" leftovers, double or trailing spaces). Returns the rules used and offending names with the problems and a cleaned-up suggestion when one is obvious. Read-only: rename with the renaming tools.

kinds.description: What to check (default views, sheets, levels): views, sheets, levels, types.

patterns.description: Override the convention with explicit regexes. Default: the office convention in knowledge/nomenclatura.md and folhas.md (REVIT_MCP_KNOWLEDGE_DIR or Documents\RevitMCP\knowledge), else hygiene checks only.

views.description: Regex every view name must match.

sheets.description: Regex every sheet number must match.

levels.description: Regex every level name must match.

types.description: Regex every family type name must match.

limit.description: Offending names listed per kind, 1-2000 (default 100); counts are always complete.

tools.name: check_required_parameters
tools.description: Check parameter rules per category: required parameters that are empty, values that must be unique (duplicate door/window Marks, room Numbers) and values that must match a regex. Without rules it checks the defaults (doors/windows: unique Mark; rooms: Name and unique Number). Returns violation groups with counts and element ids; fix them with set_parameters. Read-only.

rules.description: Rules to check. Omit for the defaults: doors and windows need a unique Mark; rooms need a Name and a unique Number.

categories.description: Categories the rule applies to, any language (OST_Doors / Doors / Portas).

required.description: Parameters that must have a value (instance first, then type).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

unique.description: Parameters whose non-empty values must be unique within each category (e.g. Mark, room Number).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

patterns.description: Parameters whose values must match a regex.

parameter.description: Parameter to check: {guid} | {builtIn} | {name} or a plain name.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

regex.description: Regular expression the (non-empty) value must match, e.g. "^P\\d{2}$".

view.description: Only elements visible in this view (name or id). Default: the whole model.

maxItemsPerGroup.description: Element ids listed per violation group, 1-1000 (default 50); counts are always complete.

tools.name: compute_room_finishes
tools.description: Compute finishes per room: floor, wall and ceiling areas in m2 grouped by the material of the bounding element's face and its type (from Revit's room geometry, finish faces), plus room area (m2) and perimeter (mm) for skirting, and totals per material for the page. Openings are not deducted beyond what Revit's room geometry already excludes. Rooms that are not enclosed are listed with the error. Read-only.

roomIds.description: Rooms to compute. Omit to use every placed room (optionally of one level).

level.description: Only rooms of this level (name or id).

tools.name: create_sheets
tools.description: Create sheets in batch (real or placeholder): number, name, title block ("Family: Type", default title block if omitted), extra parameters and optional views/schedules placed at x/y in mm. Numbers are checked for forbidden characters and collisions (also within the request) before anything is created; names are read back. One transaction (one Ctrl+Z); all or nothing unless continueOnError. Undo: Ctrl+Z, or delete the returned sheet ids.

items.description: Sheets to create, up to 200 per call.

number.description: Sheet number, unique in the document (e.g. "A-101").

titleBlock.description: Title block type as "Family: Type", type name or id. Omit for the document's default title block; "none" for no title block.

placeholder.description: Create a placeholder sheet (listed in sheet lists, not printed; no title block or views). Default false.

parameters.description: Extra sheet parameters by name, e.g. {"Desenhado por": "AE"}; same value rules as set_parameters.

views.description: Views or schedules to place on the new sheet.

view.description: View or schedule to place, by name or id.

x.description: Centre of the viewport on the sheet, from the sheet origin (bottom-left of most title blocks). Unit: mm.

y.description: Centre of the viewport on the sheet, from the sheet origin. Unit: mm.

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back every sheet of the call. true: failed sheets are skipped and listed in failed[].

tools.name: execute_batch
tools.description: Runs several tool calls against one document as a single atomic change: one Ctrl+Z undoes the whole batch. Every step is validated before anything runs; UI steps can't be mixed with model changes and only batchable tools are accepted (max 200 steps). Use "$steps[i].path" in args to pass a value from an earlier step (e.g. "$steps[0].changes.created[0]"). With dryRun the batch runs and is rolled back, returning what would change. The approval risk of a batch is the highest risk among its steps. Returns per-step results plus the combined change set.

steps.description: Steps to run in order, all against the same document.

tool.description: Name of a batchable framework tool, e.g. set_elements_pinned.

args.description: Arguments of that tool (without document/dryRun). A string "$steps[i].path" is replaced by a value from the result of an earlier step i, e.g. "$steps[0].changes.created[0]" or "$steps[1].data.viewId".

stopOnError.description: When true (default), the first failing step rolls the whole batch back. When false, failing steps are skipped (their own changes rolled back) and the others are kept.

tools.name: export_cad
tools.description: Export views or sheets to DWG or DXF (one file per view/sheet, named by fileNamePattern), optionally with a saved export setup (setupName). Writes only inside the allowed folders (default Documents\RevitMCP\exports\<document>\<timestamp>) and returns every file really written (including xref and .pcp files). The model is not changed. Long exports answer 'running' with a jobId.

viewIds.description: Views or sheets to export, by id.

sheetNumberFilter.description: Also export sheets whose number matches this pattern (* and ? wildcards, e.g. "ARQ-*").

setupName.description: Saved DWG/DXF export setup to use (Export > Options > Export Setups). Default: Revit's default options.

fileNamePattern.description: File name per view (default "{SheetNumber} - {SheetName}" for sheets, "{ViewName}" for views). Placeholders: {SheetNumber} {SheetName} {ViewName} {ViewType} {Id} {Project} {Date}.

mergedViews.description: DWG sheets: true (default) puts the views in the sheet file; false writes each view as an external reference file. Ignored for DXF.

folder.description: Output folder: absolute inside an allowed root, or relative to Documents\RevitMCP\exports. Default: exports\<document>\<timestamp>.

listOnly.description: Only list the views and file names that would be exported. Default false.

tools.name: export_elements_data
tools.description: Export the elements of some categories with chosen parameters (or all instance parameters with a value) to CSV (UTF-8 BOM, ';' and decimal comma by default) or JSON. Each row has id and uniqueId (keys for re-import with set_parameters), category, family, type and level; values are in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg) and headers carry the unit. Optional where[] and view filters. Writes only inside the allowed folders; returns the path, row/column counts and a preview.

categories.description: Categories to export, in any language: OST_Doors, Doors or Portas.

parameters.description: Parameters to export, each {guid} | {builtIn} | {name} (or a plain name). Omit to export every instance parameter that has a value (max 200 columns).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

includeTypeParameters.description: Also look the requested parameters up on the element's type when the instance doesn't have them (default true). With no parameters list, adds the type's parameters as 'type:<name>' columns.

where.description: Optional parameter conditions (same as find_elements.where), all must match.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

op.description: Operator (default eq). Text compares ignore case and accents; numbers compare in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg, %).

value.description: Value to compare with (not needed for is_empty / not_empty).

scope.description: Where to read the parameter: auto (instance, then type; default), instance or type.

view.description: Only elements visible in this view (name or id).

format.description: csv (default; UTF-8 with BOM, opens in Excel) or json. Use the server's xlsx conversion for Excel files.

decimalSeparator.description: Decimal separator for numbers in CSV: ',' (default, pt-BR) or '.'.

output.description: file (default): write the file and return its path plus the first rows; inline: return all rows (max 500).

folder.description: Output folder: absolute inside an allowed root, or relative to Documents\RevitMCP\exports. Default: exports\<document>\<timestamp>.

maxElements.description: Stop after this many elements, 1-100000 (default 20000); the result says truncated.

tools.name: export_ifc
tools.description: Export the model (or only what a view shows, via viewId) to IFC 2x3 CV2, IFC4 RV or IFC4 DTV, with optional base quantities and space boundaries. Writes only inside the allowed folders (default Documents\RevitMCP\exports\<document>\<timestamp>) and returns the file really written. The exporter runs in a transaction that is always rolled back, so the model is not changed. Large models take minutes: the call answers 'running' with a jobId (poll get_job_result).

ifcVersion.description: IFC2x3CV2 (default, Coordination View 2.0), IFC4RV (Reference View) or IFC4DTV (Design Transfer View).

viewId.description: Export only what is visible in this view (usually a 3D view). Omit to export the whole model.

exportBaseQuantities.description: Include IFC base quantities (areas, volumes). Default false.

spaceBoundaries.description: Room/space boundaries: 0 none (default), 1 first level, 2 second level.

splitWallsAndColumnsByLevel.description: Split walls and columns by building storey. Default false.

folder.description: Output folder: absolute inside an allowed root, or relative to Documents\RevitMCP\exports. Default: exports\<document>\<timestamp>.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file with the same name (default false: fail with FILE_EXISTS).

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Export sheets (by ids, sheet number wildcard or a saved view/sheet set) and/or views to PDF with Revit's PDF exporter, one file per sheet (fileNamePattern) or one combined file. Writes only inside the allowed folders (default Documents\RevitMCP\exports\<document>\<timestamp>) and returns the files really written (path, bytes) plus skipped sheets with the reason. The model is not changed. Use listOnly to preview. Long exports answer 'running' with a jobId (poll get_job_result).

viewIds.description: Other views (not sheets) to export, by id.

sheetNumberFilter.description: Sheets whose number matches this pattern: * and ? wildcards (e.g. "ARQ-1*"), case-insensitive.

viewSheetSetName.description: Name of a saved view/sheet set (Print Setup > View/Sheet Set) to export.

combine.description: true: one combined PDF; false (default): one PDF per sheet/view.

fileNamePattern.description: Per-sheet file name pattern (default "{SheetNumber} - {SheetName}"; for views "{ViewName}"). Placeholders: {SheetNumber} {SheetName} {ViewName} {ViewType} {Id} {Project} {Date}.

fileName.description: Name of the combined PDF (without extension; default "{Project} - {Date}"). Same placeholders as fileNamePattern.

folder.description: Output folder: absolute inside an allowed root, or relative to Documents\RevitMCP\exports. Default: exports\<document>\<timestamp>.

overwrite.description: Replace PDFs that already exist (default false: those sheets are skipped).

paperFormat.description: Paper: "default" (use each sheet's size, default) or A0, A1, A2, A3, A4.

rasterQuality.description: Raster quality: low, medium, high (default) or presentation.

listOnly.description: Only list what would be exported (sheets, file names, skips) without writing anything. Default false.

tools.name: find_elements
tools.description: Find elements deterministically by category (any language: OST_Walls / Walls / Paredes), family, type, level, workset, view, bounding box in mm and parameter conditions where[] (eq, neq, contains, starts_with, ends_with, regex, gt/gte/lt/lte in wire units mm/m2/m3/deg, is_empty, not_empty), reading each parameter on the instance or its type. Returns ids, names and the requested fields, ordered by id, with an exact total and limit/offset paging (countOnly for just the count). Read-only.

categories.description: Categories, in any language: OST_Walls, Walls or Paredes. Omit for all model categories.

typeName.description: Type name, or "Family: Type" (case and accents ignored).

level.description: Level name or id: only elements associated with that level.

workset.description: Workset name or id (workshared models only).

view.description: View name or id: only elements visible in that view.

bbox.description: Only elements whose bounding box intersects this box, in mm.

x.description: X coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

y.description: Y coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

z.description: Z coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

x.description: X coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

y.description: Y coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

z.description: Z coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

op.description: Operator (default eq). Text compares ignore case and accents; numbers compare in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg, %).

value.description: Value to compare with (not needed for is_empty / not_empty).

scope.description: Where to read the parameter: auto (instance, then type; default), instance or type.

fields.description: Parameters to return for each element (wire units), each {guid} | {builtIn} | {name}.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

countOnly.description: Return only the exact count (default false).

tools.name: find_undimensioned_elements
tools.description: List the elements of some categories visible in a view that no dimension in that view references (default categories: doors, windows and walls when none are given). Only dimensions in that view count; references to grids or levels don't count as dimensioning the element. Returns counts per category and ids with the element centre in mm, paged. Read-only.

view.description: View name or id (plan, section, elevation or 3D).

categories.description: Categories to check, any language (OST_Doors / Doors / Portas). Default: doors, windows and rooms (find_untagged_elements) or doors, windows and walls (find_undimensioned_elements).

tools.name: find_untagged_elements
tools.description: List the elements of some categories (default doors, windows, rooms) visible in a view that have no tag in that view (element tags, room/space/area tags; tags of linked elements are ignored). Returns counts per category and ids with the element centre in mm, paged. Read-only.

view.description: View name or id (plan, section, elevation or 3D).

categories.description: Categories to check, any language (OST_Doors / Doors / Portas). Default: doors, windows and rooms (find_untagged_elements) or doors, windows and walls (find_undimensioned_elements).

tools.name: get_element_parameters
tools.description: Read the parameters of one or more elements (instance and/or type), with metadata: name, builtIn, guid, storage type, data type, group, read-only flag, value in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg, %; ElementId values as the referenced element's name, raw id in 'raw'), and Revit's display text. Use builtIn or guid from the result to reference a parameter unambiguously in set_parameters. Elements inside links are readable with "linkInstanceId:elementId". Paged by element. Read-only.

elementIds.description: Elements to read, as strings: element id ("123456"), UniqueId, or "linkInstanceId:elementId" for an element inside a Revit link. Type ids work too.

scope.description: instance = the element's own parameters; type = its type's; both = both (default).

parameters.description: Only these parameters, each {guid} | {builtIn} | {name}. Omit for all parameters.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

includeEmpty.description: Include parameters without a value (default true).

limit.description: Maximum number of elements returned (1-200, default 50).

offset.description: Number of elements to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: get_model_health
tools.description: Model check-up: score 0-100 and grade A-F from warnings, imported (not linked) CAD, in-place families, model groups, views not on sheets, detail lines, unplaced/unenclosed rooms, file size and (deep: true) purgeable families/types. Returns every metric, the penalty it cost and prioritized findings with the fix and the tool to use next (get_model_warnings, purge_unused, audit_sheets_views, audit_families...). Read-only.

deep.description: Also count purgeable families/types (slower on big models). Default false.

topN.description: How many top warning types to show, 0-20 (default 5).

tools.name: get_model_warnings
tools.description: Summarize the model's warnings (Review Warnings) grouped by warning type - the language-neutral FailureDefinitionId, so pt-BR and English texts group the same - or by category. Each group has count, distinct elements, the text in Revit's language, example element ids and, for common types, a suggested fix. Largest groups first, paged. Read-only.

groupBy.description: definition (default): one group per warning type (FailureDefinitionId, language-neutral); category: by the category of the first failing element.

categories.description: Only warnings involving elements of these categories (any language: OST_Walls / Walls / Paredes).

maxExamplesPerGroup.description: Example warnings (with element ids) per group, 0-50 (default 5).

limit.description: Groups per page, 1-500 (default 50), largest groups first.

tools.name: get_session_context
tools.description: Call first. Returns this Revit session's state: add-in version and capabilityHash (compare with the server's manifest to detect an outdated add-in), Revit version/build/language, every open document (docId, title, isFamilyDocument, isWorkshared, isActive, isReadOnly, isModified), the active document, the targeted document, the active view and the number of queued tool calls.

tools.name: get_view_image
tools.description: Render one view or sheet, by id, to a PNG (or JPG) and return it as an image the assistant can look at (data.image), sized by pixels/fitDirection. Optionally keep the file in an allowed folder (saveTo). Schedules can't be rendered. Read-only: the model is not changed.

viewId.description: Id of the view or sheet to render (any document view; it does not need to be open).

pixels.description: Image size in pixels along fitDirection, 64-4096 (default 1600). Big images cost many tokens.

fitDirection.description: Which side 'pixels' applies to: horizontal (default) or vertical.

returnImage.description: Return the image so the assistant can see it (default true). false only saves the file (needs saveTo).

saveTo.description: Optional folder to keep the image in (absolute inside an allowed root, or relative to Documents\RevitMCP\exports).

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: List the tools the installed Revit add-in provides, with kind (read/write/ui), risk, toolset, whether it changes the model, whether it needs the user's approval (risk medium or high), batchable, idempotent and timeout. Filter by text, kind or toolset. Works with no document open.

contains.description: Only tools whose name or description contains this text (case and accents ignored).

kind.description: Only tools of this kind: read, write or ui.

toolset.description: Only tools of this toolset (core, query, parameters, sheets, export, qa, documents, ...).

includeDescriptions.description: Include each tool's full description (default false: first sentence only).

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the Revit links (type id, name, path, loaded/unloaded/not found, attachment or overlay, nested, instance count) and the CAD files (linked vs imported, path, status, instances and the view owning view-specific ones). Use the linkTypeId with manage_links to reload or unload. Read-only.

kind.description: rvt (Revit links), cad (linked and imported DWG/DXF/DGN/SKP...) or all (default).

tools.name: list_recent_models
tools.description: List the models Revit opened recently (its MRU list in Revit.ini), most recent first, with path, whether the file still exists, last modified time and size. Works with no document open. Use it to find a model to open. Read-only.

revitVersion.description: Revit version whose recent list to read, e.g. "2025". Default: the running Revit.

tools.name: manage_links
tools.description: Reload or unload Revit links by link type id (from list_links). Reload re-reads the file from its saved path (fails with the reason if the file is missing); unload removes the link's geometry from the session until reloaded. Neither can be undone with Ctrl+Z: undo an unload with reload. dryRun lists what would happen. CAD links are listed by list_links but not managed here.

operation.description: reload (reload from the saved path) or unload.

linkTypeIds.description: Revit link type ids (linkTypeId from list_links).

tools.name: purge_unused
tools.description: Find and (with apply: true) delete unused families, types, materials and patterns - the same list as Revit's Purge Unused on 2024+ (older versions: families and types only). By default it only lists (apply false); dryRun: true previews the exact deletions with real ids. exclude[] protects names by regex. Repeats up to 'passes' times to catch cascades. Undo: Ctrl+Z (one transaction).

targets.description: What to purge (default families, types, materials): families, types, materials, fillPatterns, linePatterns, viewTemplates, other.

apply.description: false (default): only list what is unused (nothing is deleted). true: delete it (one Ctrl+Z undoes the whole purge).

exclude.description: Regular expressions on the element name; matching elements are never purged (e.g. "^Carimbo", "_PADRAO$").

maxElements.description: Delete at most this many elements in one call, 1-10000 (default 2000).

passes.description: apply only: repeat the purge up to this many times, 1-5 (default 3), since deleting a family can free its nested families and materials.

listLimit.description: Maximum items listed in the result, 0-2000 (default 300); counts are always complete.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the target document to its own file, or Save As a new file inside the allowed folders (saveAsPath). Workshared models are saved locally only: it never synchronizes with central (ask the user to sync in Revit), and Save As is refused for them. A never-saved document needs saveAsPath. Saving can't be undone; dryRun reports what would be saved.

saveAsPath.description: Save a copy under a new name (Save As): absolute inside an allowed root, or relative to Documents\RevitMCP\models. The document then points to the new file. Not allowed for workshared models.

overwrite.description: Save As only: replace an existing file (default false: fail with FILE_EXISTS).

compact.description: Compact the file while saving (slower, smaller). Default false.

tools.name: set_elements_pinned
tools.description: Pins or unpins elements by id in the target document. Elements already in the requested state are reported as unchanged; ids that don't exist are reported as notFound. Undo with Ctrl+Z or by calling it again with the opposite value. Supports dryRun.

elementIds.description: Ids of the elements to pin or unpin.

pinned.description: true pins the elements (they can't be moved or deleted by accident); false unpins them.

tools.name: set_parameters
tools.description: Write instance parameter values on 1..500 elements in one transaction (one Ctrl+Z). Reference parameters by guid, builtIn or name; numbers in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg, %), ElementId parameters by id or name. Every write is read back: values Revit changed (formulas, rounding) come back as 'mismatch'. Atomic by default. Critical parameters (type, level, phase, workset, host) are blocked unless allowCritical. Type parameters are refused here: use set_type_parameters. Undo: Ctrl+Z, or send the returned revert[] back to this tool.

items.description: Writes to apply: one {elementId, parameter, value, unit?} per value. Up to 500 per call.

elementId.description: Element id or UniqueId, as a string.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

value.description: New value. Numbers in wire units (length mm, area m2, volume m3, angle deg, slope %); yes/no as true/false; ElementId parameters take an id or a name (level, phase, material, type); null clears text and ElementId values.

unit.description: Optional unit for this number instead of the wire default: m, cm, mm, ft, in, m2, ft2, m3, l, deg, rad, %, ratio, or internal (raw Revit value).

elementIds.description: Shortcut for the same value on several elements: element ids (strings), used with parameter + value instead of items.

parameter.description: Shortcut: the parameter to write on every element of elementIds.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

value.description: Shortcut: the value to write on every element of elementIds (same rules as items[].value).

unit.description: Shortcut: optional unit override for value.

atomic.description: true (default): all or nothing — any invalid item, refused value or read-back mismatch rolls the whole call back. false: valid items are written and the rest reported in items[] with their status.

allowCritical.description: Allow parameters that change what an element is or where it lives (type, levels and constraints, phases, workset, host) and one Mark on many elements. Default false.

tools.name: set_type_parameters
tools.description: Write TYPE parameter values (affects every instance of the type; result reports instancesAffected). elementId may be a type id or an instance id (its type is used). Same rules as set_parameters: guid/builtIn/name references, wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg, %), read-back with 'mismatch', atomic by default, critical parameters blocked unless allowCritical. Needs human approval. Undo: Ctrl+Z, or send revert[] back to this tool.

tools.name: warnings_delta
tools.description: Track warnings across a work session: operation baseline saves the current warnings (per document, to a file in Documents\RevitMCP\qa), and operation delta reports which warnings are new and which were resolved since then, grouped by warning type, with element ids. Run baseline before a change and delta after it to prove the change introduced no warnings. Does not change the model.

operation.description: baseline: snapshot the current warnings to a file (replaces the previous baseline of that name); delta: compare the current warnings with the baseline.

baselineName.description: Name of the baseline (letters, digits, - and _; default "default"). Baselines are per document.

limit.description: Delta: new/resolved warnings listed per page, 1-1000 (default 100).

offset.description: Delta: items to skip in the new/resolved lists (default 0).
